title: Canonical integral reduction adjunction and quotient transitions
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $X$, a finite-field datum $D$ of characteristic $p$ with $\ell\ne p$, and the completed and finite coefficient sheaves $R_X=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}B_{n,X}$, $B_{n,X}=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n)_X$ and canonical quotient restrictions of [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. Let $L_n:D(R_X)\to D(B_{n,X})$ be integral derived reduction [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], and $\operatorname{Res}_n$ restriction along $R_X\to B_{n,X}$. Define $\mathfrak a_n:L_n\dashv\operatorname{Res}_n$ to be the actual tensor-unit-normalized derived adjunction of [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction], with unit $\eta_n$. For every $m\ge n\ge1$ and $M\in D(R_X)$ define the canonical semilinear reduction transition $t_{m,n}(M):L_mM\to\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}(L_nM)$ as the inverse Hom-adjunction image under $\mathfrak a_m$ of the composite $M\xrightarrow{\eta_n}\operatorname{Res}_n L_nM\xrightarrow{e_{m,n}^{-1}}\operatorname{Res}_m\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}L_nM$, where $e_{m,n}:\operatorname{Res}_m\circ\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}\cong\operatorname{Res}_n$ is the canonical restriction comparison induced by the completion projection equation. This defines the actual transitions for all quotient pairs, including equal indices; it asserts no finiteness or effectivity theorem.
